faq.q_en: If AI writes the code, what do you do?
faq.a_en: I decide what to build and how we'll know it works. Claude Code writes most of the code; I review every change and accept it through tests and walkthroughs.
faq.q_zh: AI 写代码，那你做什么？
faq.a_zh: 做什么、怎样判断它真的可行，由我来决定。大部分代码由 Claude Code 编写；每一处改动我都会亲自审查，并通过测试和实际走查来验收。

faq.q_en: How do you know an AI feature really works?
faq.a_en: By testing it on questions it never saw while it was being tuned. In Storewright's regional supply-chain part, the duty assistant got 76.3% of an 80-question held-out set fully correct, against 42.5% for keyword rules.
faq.q_zh: 怎么知道 AI 做的功能真的管用？
faq.a_zh: 用它在调整时从没见过的题来测。Storewright 区域供应链部分的值班助手，在 80 道盲测题上四项全对 76.3%，只用关键词规则是 42.5%。

faq.q_en: Which AI tools do you use?
faq.a_en: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok for planning and building; also GitHub Copilot, and Suno for music.
faq.q_zh: 你用哪些 AI 工具？
faq.a_zh: 用 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、DeepSeek 和 Grok 规划和开发；也用 GitHub Copilot，用 Suno 做音乐。
